testcase.system-out: Scenario: Stop wheel navigation at the visible ends of the part ribbon ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full ribbon visible ✔ And the 3D Model tab is the first visible command tab and is active ✔ When the user scrolls up over the 3D Model tab ✔ Then the 3D Model tab remains active ✔ And its command groups remain visible ✔ When the user selects the last visible command tab ✔ And the user scrolls down over the last visible command tab ✔ Then the last visible command tab remains active ✔ And its command groups remain visible ✔ And the part remains visible
